name: HA-2600 / HA-2602 / HA-2605 and HA-2620 / HA-2622 / HA-2625 (Harris high-input-impedance bipolar singles)
tagline: Harris 500 Mohm bipolar singles: HA-2600/2605 (12 MHz, 7 V/us) and uncompensated HA-2620/2625 (100 MHz GBW, 35 V/us, gain >5). Jung-era audio praise unverified.
technology: Bipolar single op-amps with very high input impedance (500 Mohm, HA-2600/HA-2620) per Intersil/Renesas datasheets. HA-2600/2602/2605 are internally compensated (12 MHz unity-gain bandwidth, 7 V/us, 150 kV/V). HA-2620/2622/2625 are the 'very wideband, uncompensated' versions (100 MHz GBW, stable for closed-loop gain >5, 35 V/us, 150 kV/V). Dielectric-isolation process and input-stage topology were not confirmed from a datasheet this run.
manufacturers: Renesas (acquired Intersil; still hosts datasheets and product pages)

reputation.summary: No Hi-Fi community praise was verified. No search budget was spent on reputation this run. Discovery notes say these Harris parts were cited in late-1970s/1980s Walt Jung-era audio literature as high-slew, high-impedance options, and that modern enthusiast praise is minimal. Treat this as a historical tier-C entry until the Jung citations are confirmed.
typical_uses: High-slew line-level and instrumentation stages in the slew-induced-distortion era (per discovery notes, unverified)
High-gain amplification of fast wideband signals from high-impedance sources (HA-2620/2625 at gain >5, per the datasheet description)
caveats: HA-2620/2622/2625 are uncompensated and stable only at closed-loop gains greater than 5 (datasheet). Do not use them as unity-gain followers or in low-gain audio stages.
HA3-2625-5 is obsolete per distributors. Other codes probably come only from surplus, new-old stock or Rochester Electronics.
Grade-specific values here come from EWB/MicroSim simulator libraries. Only headline typicals were confirmed from datasheets.
Noise (e_n, i_n), THD, quiescent current and supply range were not verified.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit or remarking reports were found. This run used no search on it, so this is a gap, not a clean bill. HA3-2625-5 is obsolete per distributors. Current supply is likely surplus, new-old stock or Rochester Electronics, which has a datasheet copy filed under HA2-2625-5 on Octopart. For surplus parts, check that logos and date codes match the Harris or Intersil era. Measure the slew rate (about 7 vs about 35 V/us) and unity-gain stability to tell a 2600-series die from an uncompensated 2620-series die: a 2620/2625 will oscillate as a follower.

revision_chain_notes:
HA-2600 datasheet chain (Harris 'File Number 2902', later Intersil FN2902), oldest to newest:
- Harris databook listing from 1982 (already in the chain). Standalone Harris revisions 2902.0 and 2902.1 are MISSING.
- File Number 2902.2 (1996): Harris combined HA-2600/HA-2602/HA-2605 edition. Holding copy not confirmed; the ropla.eu mirror is a likely candidate.
- File Number 2902.3 (September 1998): Intersil, HA-2600 only.
- 2902.4, .5 and .6 are MISSING. The Octopart JM38510-12202BGC copy uses the '1 ®' Intersil template of 1998-2005, so it probably holds one of 2902.3 to 2902.6, but this is not confirmed.
- FN2902.7 / Rev 7.00 (January 16, 2006): Intersil. Renesas hosts it re-templated as 'FN2902 Rev 7.00' (9 pages).
- Any Intersil 'DATASHEET'-template or later Renesas reissue after Rev 7.00 is not known.

HA-2620 datasheet chain (Harris 'File Number 2903', later Intersil FN2903):
- Harris-era 'HA-2620, HA-2622, HA-2625' combined edition (RS Online, Manualzz and alldatasheet 120393 copies). Its revision suffix and date are still MISSING; a search for 2903.x with 1995-1997 dates returned nothing.
- 2903.0 to 2903.5 are MISSING.
- FN2903.6 (June 2003): the 'HA-2620, HA-2625' edition, with HA-2622 dropped from the title. The Digi-Key copy holds it.
- A later Intersil 'DATASHEET'-template edition exists (the Sekorm copy), but its revision number (.7 or later) and date are MISSING. The revision of the current Renesas-hosted copy is also unconfirmed.

HA-2600/883 and HA-2602/883 military datasheet: the file number, revisions and dates are all MISSING. Only mirrors are known: datasheetcatalog, plus the Jotrin HA2-2600/883 page added here.

Second sources: none found in these searches.
